description: Generate valid JSON-LD schema markup for Article, LocalBusiness, Product and FAQ pages.

faqs.a: Choose the schema type, fill in the fields, and click Generate. The tool builds schema.org-compliant JSON-LD you can paste into your page's <head>.
faqs.q: How do I generate schema markup?

faqs.a: Yes — validate the output with Google's Rich Results Test before publishing.
faqs.q: Is the output valid for Google rich results?

faqs.a: JSON-LD is Google's recommended format for structured data — a script block your page carries invisibly.
Article, LocalBusiness, Product and FAQPage are covered here; dedicated FAQ, Breadcrumb, Review and HowTo generators exist as separate tools.

howto: Pick a schema type: Article, LocalBusiness, Product or FAQ.
Fill in the fields for that type.
Copy the JSON-LD or download it, then paste into your page <head>.
title: Schema Markup Generator
